plainLanguage: Section 130 — Rape. Ufafanuzi huu unafuata vipengele vya statutory text ya R.E. 2022 bila kubadilisha official wording.
meaning: Section 130 must be read together with the precise statutory definitions, circumstances, evidential rules and punishment provisions that apply to the offence.
keyPoints: Use the exact statutory elements and age thresholds stated in the R.E. 2022 text.
Consent, authority, penetration, participation, intention and other circumstances matter only as the relevant provision specifies.
Do not substitute the explanation for the official statutory wording.

history.summary: Section 130 appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text verified against the government-hosted R.E. 2022 Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each express element, circumstance and threshold should be proved rather than inferred from the offence label.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The analysis should distinguish the definition of the offence, evidential rules and sentencing provisions.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory element inayohitajika na section 130?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
